items.body: A shell command ran in the foreground for 9 minutes and Claude waited for it. Builds and test suites that take more than a minute can run in the background: Claude keeps working and hears when they finish.
items.evidence: a foreground Bash call longer than a minute; Claude waited for it
items.explain: A foreground Bash call blocks the turn until it exits. For builds and test suites that take more than a minute, run them in the background (`run_in_background`): Claude keeps working and is notified when the command finishes. Calls Claude Code backgrounded itself do not count.
items.fix_prompt: Run builds and test suites longer than a minute in the background and keep working meanwhile.
items.foot: goes away when Claude backgrounds a command, or after three turns
items.headline: A shell command blocked the turn for 9:09
items.name: A long command blocked the turn
